title: Clara works the night shift
topic: A nurse named Clara works a quiet night shift in a hospital: an old man calls for water, a doctor checks the charts, the shift ends at seven
tail_E: With a thin needle she takes a small sample of his
target_note: 'blood' is the natural completion of 'with a thin needle she takes a small sample of his' in a hospital context (nurse, patients, doctor, bandage); the word does not occur in the units or the tail, nor does its German equivalent 'Blut'. ' blood' is a single Pythia token (id 2614). Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only): p(' blood') = 0.64 on the all-English rendering, rank 1; a tail with 'drops of' was rejected because the water of unit 4 made ' water' the top prediction.
author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, family F07 (nurse Clara / night shift)
notes: Ten units: Clara begins her shift; she reads the patient list; an old man presses the call button; the nurse brings water; the monitors beep; a doctor checks the charts; Clara changes a bandage; the old man sleeps; the night passes quietly; the shift ends. Subjects alternate between the protagonist (Clara / she / the nurse), other people (an old man, a young doctor) and objects (the monitors, the night, the shift), so that C3 switches cross singular and plural subject-verb agreement. No separable verbs are used. Present tense and positive polarity throughout.
